description: This file defines a Spring Batch Tasklet named UpdateNpaTasklet, responsible for updating the 'is_npa' status of loans in the database based on certain criteria. It contains logic for generating and executing SQL update statements to set the NPA status on loans according to their overdue status and other related conditions.

classes.name: UpdateNpaTasklet
classes.description: A Spring Batch Tasklet that updates the 'is_npa' status of loans in the database by executing dynamically generated SQL based on loan overdue statuses and other criteria.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the tasklet logic to reset and update the 'is_npa' status for loans in the database based on defined business rules.
